\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 271-274 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R279-first-pass-words-from-chapters-271-274}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a tulip and jasmine.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item free, foreign, local, official, private
  \item honest, cheeky, sensitive, pink, dark
  \item boring, useful, traditional, suitable, possible
  \item a heater, a shelf, a price, a discount, a banknote
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Free? (\textbf{\fa{آزاد}}, \emph{âzâd}.) Foreign? (\textbf{\fa{خارجی}}, \emph{khâreji}.) Local? (\textbf{\fa{محلی}}, \emph{mahalli}.) Official? (\textbf{\fa{رسمی}}, \emph{rasmi}.) Private? (\textbf{\fa{خصوصی}}, \emph{khosusi}.) Honest? (\textbf{\fa{راستگو}}, \emph{rostgu}.) Cheeky? (\textbf{\fa{پررو}}, \emph{porru}.) Sensitive? (\textbf{\fa{حساس}}, \emph{hasâs}.) Pink? (\textbf{\fa{صورتی}}, \emph{surati}.) Dark? (\textbf{\fa{تاریک}}, \emph{târik}.) Boring? (\textbf{\fa{کسل} \fa{کننده}}, \emph{kesel-konande}.) Useful? (\textbf{\fa{مفید}}, \emph{mofid}.) Traditional? (\textbf{\fa{سنتی}}, \emph{sonnati}.) Suitable? (\textbf{\fa{مناسب}}, \emph{monâseb}.) Possible? (\textbf{\fa{ممکن}}, \emph{momken}.) A heater? (\textbf{\fa{بخاری}}, \emph{bokhâri}.) A shelf? (\textbf{\fa{قفسه}}, \emph{qafase}.) A price? (\textbf{\fa{قیمت}}, \emph{qeymat}.) A discount? (\textbf{\fa{تخفیف}}, \emph{takhfif}.) A banknote? (\textbf{\fa{اسکناس}}, \emph{eskenâs}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 275-279 — a second pass}

  \item vinegar, flour, a number, a text message, an email

  \item a spread cloth, a secret, a team, a prize, respect
  \item a cypress, a plane tree, a palm tree, a tulip, jasmine

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Lettuce? (\textbf{\fa{کاهو}}, \emph{kâhu}.) Cabbage? (\textbf{\fa{کلم}}, \emph{kalam}.) A mushroom? (\textbf{\fa{قارچ}}, \emph{qârch}.) Cinnamon? (\textbf{\fa{دارچین}}, \emph{dârchin}.) Cream? (\textbf{\fa{خامه}}, \emph{khâme}.) Vinegar? (\textbf{\fa{سرکه}}, \emph{serke}.) Flour? (\textbf{\fa{آرد}}, \emph{ârd}.) A number? (\textbf{\fa{شماره}}, \emph{shomâre}.) A text message? (\textbf{\fa{پیامک}}, \emph{payâmak}.) An email? (\textbf{\fa{ایمیل}}, \emph{imeyl}.) Parents? (\textbf{\fa{والدین}}, \emph{vâledeyn}.) A fiancé? (\textbf{\fa{نامزد}}, \emph{nâmzad}.) A bridegroom? (\textbf{\fa{داماد}}, \emph{dâmâd}.) Relatives? (\textbf{\fa{فامیل}}, \emph{fâmil}.) A teenager? (\textbf{\fa{نوجوان}}, \emph{nojavân}.) A spread cloth? (\textbf{\fa{سفره}}, \emph{sofre}.) A secret? (\textbf{\fa{راز}}, \emph{râz}.) A team? (\textbf{\fa{تیم}}, \emph{tim}.) A prize? (\textbf{\fa{جایزه}}, \emph{jâyeze}.) Respect? (\textbf{\fa{احترام}}, \emph{ehterâm}.) A cypress? (\textbf{\fa{سرو}}, \emph{sarv}.) A plane tree? (\textbf{\fa{چنار}}, \emph{chenâr}.) A palm tree? (\textbf{\fa{نخل}}, \emph{nakhl}.) A tulip? (\textbf{\fa{لاله}}, \emph{lâle}.) Jasmine?
